key_unknowns: Segment EBITDA is not disclosed — the filing segments revenue but NOT segment EBITDA, so the standalone profitability and ROIC of the Cloud/AI build cannot be isolated from the Services engine funding it (a missing expected disclosure).
No forward EV/EBITDA on an adjusted basis and no revised guidance at the drawdown — the trailing 22.9x at the 92nd percentile cannot be reconciled against a normalized forward level.

The trailing P/E percentile cannot be built because a stock split inside the window divides split-adjusted prices against as-filed EPS — the 'cheap' 14.6x P/E stands but its historical context is unavailable.

CIQ's stated 22.9x EV/EBITDA does not reproduce against reported LTM EBITDA $185,516M (its implied denominator is $144,827M, -21.9%) — read CIQ's own denominator before comparing it with any reported-EBITDA multiple.

The two FCF bases carry OPPOSITE signs on the same period — CIQ Levered FCF -$1,162.5M vs CFO $179,551M − capex $159,804M = +$19,747M — so whether the business generated or consumed cash this period depends entirely on the basis named.

The consensus EBITDA estimate row is NOT the same basis as the actual row (implied D&A 73,132 vs 12,710, 5.75x divergent) — forward multiples struck off estimates are not directly comparable to trailing multiples off actuals.
Covenant terms are UNKNOWN — no agreement exhibit was located to extract from; a material gap in understanding any restrictions on the debt-funded capex ramp.

FY26E/FY27E capex guidance of $(195,000)–$(205,000)M is fresh and the delivery track record is 'MET', but the 2027 capex figure ('significant increase') is unquantified — the magnitude of the forward spend is not yet disclosed.

Future purchase commitments of $924B and pre-commencement leases of $152B (management-stated maximums) are large relative to the business and their variable-pricing flexibility is not quantified in the structured data.

caveats: NOT A CURRENT SCREEN CANDIDATE — assembled because the name carries an operator follow decision — Alphabet Class A, HELD — a $50,000 / 5.0% NAV starter entered 2026-08-14 at ~$345 under an external IC memo, recorded here so the machinery can see a live position it was previously blind to. Followed under the QUALITY book: the binding question is duration — whether Search and Cloud economics outlast what a ~26x normalized NTM multiple already pays for — not whether a de-rating is overdone, which is the overshoot twin's question and the wrong one here. The $300M-$10B band answers where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow, and this name is covered deliberately from outside it. Class A specifically: the memo, the $345.90 verified close and the frozen legs are all Class A, and GOOG (Class C) is a distinct security. The cap band decides where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow, so absence from it is not a rejection — read the verdict, not the absence: no screen run on file has evaluated it.

historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Revenue × margin scenario: the SAME year's Revenue pct_error and ratio_error, kept together. ratio_error alone answers how wrong the margin (or capex-intensity) forecast was, and multiplied by revenue it drops the revenue miss's effect. Exact identity: error_per_forecast_revenue = ratio_error + (actual ÷ actual revenue) × (actual revenue ÷ forecast revenue − 1).
